To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a PGC-α isoform induced by resistance exercise regulates skeletal muscle hypertrophy.
we have identified a form PGC-1 that is induced by resistance exercise and that induces muscle growth by regulating IGF1 and myostatin.
a form of Pgc-1α, Pgc-1a4, is induced in skeletal muscle by resistance exercise and is required for muscle hypertrophy and strength.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the regulation of skeletal muscle mass.
the molecular mechanisms that control the growth and maintenance of skeletal muscle, and how the molecular mechanisms of muscle growth and maintenance are altered in the context of disease.
understanding the molecular and cellular mechanisms that control the development and regeneration of skeletal muscle.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the PGC-1 isoform PGC-1alpha4 regulates skeletal muscle hypertrophy by inducing IGF-1 and repressing myostatin.
PGC-1alpha4 is a protein that regulates and co-ordinates factors involved in skeletal hypertrophy.
PGC-1alpha is a transcriptional cofactor that regulates skeletal muscle mass by activating IGF1 and inhibiting Myostatin.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
PGC-1alpha is a transcription co-activator induced by endurance exercise that gives muscle most known adaptations to exercise, but it does not regulate muscle hypertrophy or strength.

we have identified an exercise-inducible form of PGC1-α that is preferentially expressed in human skeletal muscle during resistance exercise and that is sufficient to promote muscle hypertrophy and resistance to muscle atrophy.
PGC-1alpha4 is an exercise-inducible isoform of PGC- 1alpha that is expressed in human and mouse muscle in response to resistance exercise.
The main takeaway from our work is that
there are at least two distinct isoforms of PGC- 1α, one that regulates mitochondrial function and endurance and one that regulates hypertrophy.
PGC-1 is not the same as PGC-1.
PGC-1alpha is a master coordinator of skeletal muscle metabolism.
